description: React component for managing and editing a draft persona, including loading, saving, regenerating, and finalizing draft personas with local storage and backend API interactions.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string into an object, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into an array of CareerHighlightItem objects, handling string and object formats.

methods.name: looksLikePersonaDraftSchema
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object matches the PersonaDraftSchema shape.

methods.name: looksLikeLegacyDraft
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object matches the LegacyDraftPersona shape.

methods.name: toEditableModel
methods.description: Converts draft JSON into an EditableDraftModel, handling different schema versions.

methods.name: applyEditsToDraft
methods.description: Applies user edits to the original draft JSON, preserving schema structure.

methods.name: fetchLatestPersistedDraft
methods.description: Fetches the latest draft JSON from backend API for a given persona ID.
